"This month I brought you the "What if" story of Futaba Sakura. It is a sad story and you probably all knew her "if" ending would be - yes, she ended her life because of the guilty feelings wrongly put onto her head.

It is the first time I really tried to draw hanging. I personally don't find hanging "hard" enough for my taste, but I am still exploring all kinds of stuff, both for the fans of hanging and a logical story. I also added the morgue examining and necro part to the story, which is another subject I used to dislike, but somehow after the time I drew Ann and Shiho, I kinda understand the interest now.

Since I don't feel much about these topics, i don't even know if i did a good job to make you feel something. Why don't you make it in the comment to see if i did fine? Hope you feel it from this story. Thank you!"
